text:
Maya (CS): Hey team — kicking off Aster Labs onboarding. Main goals: 1) Sandbox connected; 2) First integration test within 14 days; 3) Initial KPI dashboard (latency/cost per route) by day 30. Who can own each?
Marco (CSM): I can own success criteria and weekly sync cadences. Will run stakeholder RACI.
Jordan (Aster Labs): Thanks — Jordan here (Platform). Our primary constraint is compliance review (SaaS data path) + SSO. 14 days for an integration test seems tight but achievable if we get SSO creds early.
Samir (Solutions): I'll take the technical lead for integration. Need model selection + sample payloads. Can we get a small test dataset and network details?
Elena (CS Ops): I'll schedule the recurring 30-min standups. Also logging requirements: Aster needs audit logs retained 90 days. Added to checklist.
Maya (CS): Assigning: Marco -> stakeholder ops & org RACI, Samir -> tech lead, Elena -> ops & runbooks, Maya -> onboarding milestones + renewals watch. Jordan -> provide SSO contact + sample payloads.
Jordan (Aster Labs): Assigning @Priya (security) for the compliance sign-off. Priya will likely need the diagram + data flow.
Samir (Solutions): Sharing minimal timeline suggestion:
```
Week 0: Kickoff + collect creds (SSO/KMS contact)
Week 1: Sandbox network setup + first smoke tests
Week 2: Integration test (end-to-end) + perf baseline
Week 3: Observability + dashboard template + runbook handoff
Week 4: Internal enablement + customer demo + success criteria review
```
Elena (CS Ops): Risks: - If compliance sign-off delayed >2 weeks, renewal risk flag. - Network firewall rules often take 3rd-party lead time. I'll add contingency buffer to the timeline.
Marco (CSM): Success criteria (proposed): - Authenticated calls from Aster prod net => 95% success within baseline latency; - Dashboard shows cost/token < target; - Two internal PTs sign off on quality.
Jordan (Aster Labs): Confirming SSO contact: priya@asterlabs.com. We can share a sample payload by EOD tomorrow.
Maya (CS): Quick ask: can Samir and Jordan join a 45-min deep-dive tomorrow 11:00am PT? Purpose: network + KMS + sample payload review.
Samir (Solutions): Yup, I can. Posting quick pre-reqs: please provide (1) SAML metadata or OIDC issuer URL; (2) sample request/response; (3) CIDR for tunnel.
Jordan (Aster Labs): Will send all three items by EOD.
onboarding-bot: Meeting scheduled: "Aster Labs — Onboarding deep dive" tomorrow 11:00am PT. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood-internal/meet/aster-deepdive
Elena (CS Ops): I'll create the onboarding runbook template and share in the doc: https://redwood.docs/onboarding/aster-labs (draft).
Maya (CS): Great — next steps: 1) Jordan shares artifacts (EOD), 2) Samir/Marco review and prep, 3) Elena publishes runbook draft. We'll reconvene after the deep-dive to lock timelines and ship the Week 1 plan. :thumbsup:
Jordan (Aster Labs): Thanks all — excited to get started.
Marco (CSM): Noted. I'll also add a renewal watch flag and cadence to the CRM: 60/30/14 day check-ins.
Maya (CS): Perfect. I'll create the persistent thread and add milestones to the onboarding board. If anything blocks, drop here. :rocket:
